I am not overweighting because the rank is high; I am overweighting because it passes the only leg with actual edge.

theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is scorable (3033.HK) and ineligible with a mean-revert Hurst tag — the only validated edge says trend-gate ineligibility removes the drawdown-avoidance support.
